svg.aria-label: 수신 아키텍처 4종 비교 — 슈퍼헤테로다인, Zero-IF, Low-IF, 직접 RF 샘플링
svg.title: 수신 아키텍처 4종 비교 — 슈퍼헤테로다인, Zero-IF, Low-IF, 직접 RF 샘플링
svg.text: Four receiver architectures, same drawing style
+ no image filter, no IF SAW
- 1/f noise sits right on the signal
- I/Q imbalance folds the channel onto itself
the dominant choice in modern integrated radios
+ moves the signal off DC and off 1/f noise
- the adjacent channel becomes the image
used by Bluetooth, many IoT radios
+ no analogue mixer, no I/Q imbalance at all
+ one radio covers many bands in software
- the ADC must swallow the whole band
- high power, and clock jitter now limits SNR
- an out-of-band signal aliases straight in
Every architecture keeps the same jobs - filter, amplify, shift, digitise. Only WHERE each job happens changes.
